text:
rachel: quick design QA for compact playground: main spots 1) Stop/regenerate semantics 2) token pill announcements 3) prompt library keyboard + pin. dropping a couple frames soon.

dave: nice. first: label for primary action should stay short. propose "Stop" with a microcaption: "Stops stream 1 partial output retained" visible on hover and always to screen readers.

mina: agree. mobile long-press can surface "Discard" as secondary. default tap = keep partial. avoid hidden gestures as primary.

a11y-bot: accessibility note: token counter updates during streaming are noisy. debounce announcements 200ms, aria-live="polite" for increments, aria-live="assertive" for final statuses like "generation stopped". set interim animated numbers aria-hidden=true.

owen: UX nit: show small spinner in token pill while reconciling server count. make hit target >=44px; use focus ring fallback color from design tokens; respect prefers-reduced-motion for animations.

dave: prompt library: arrow nav + Enter to insert, Space to pin. each item needs role="button" and a visually-hidden label: "Insert prompt: <title>". change header from "Saved prompts" to "Prompt library".

rachel: telemetry: consolidate events to \`playground.interrupt\` with method enum {"stop","discard","regen"}. sample telemetry.track('playground.interrupt',{method:'stop',visible_tokens:12,variant:'compact-v1'})

mina: regen race: if a regen is requested while the previous stream is tearing down we can double-bill on dedicated infra. filing INF-11500 and adding client-side regen-lock + server idempotency key.

a11y-bot: checklist for devs: stop caption + long-press menu, token debounce+spinner+aria rules, pill hit-area + focus ring, prompt keyboard nav + hidden labels, telemetry rename, INF-11500.

rachel: i'll update Figma and handoff tokens tomorrow. quick voiceover pass once frames are in staging?

owen: happy to run VoiceOver. ping me when staging flag is on.

rachel: thanks everyone 1 pinned landing checklist in this thread.
